# @aeon-ui/signal

Framework-agnostic audio analysis and bar motion smoothing for visualizers. Optional sibling to the control-plane packages — see [SCENE.md](../../SCENE.md).

```ts
import { attachMediaAnalyser, bandRanges, stepBarMotion, createBarMotionState } from '@aeon-ui/signal'
```

Pair with `@aeon-ui/react-scene` for React bindings, or drive canvas/SVG yourself from the motion state.
